task draw(s)
  title('Agenda')
  show(1, 1, s.day & ' ' & weekday(s.day))
  set rows to []
  for each e in s.events
    when e.date is s.day
      add e.time & ' ' & e.title to rows
    done
  done
  set rows to sort(rows)
  when count(rows) is 0
    show(3, 1, '(no events)')
  done
  set r to 3
  for each l in rows
    when r <= 23
      show(r, 1, l)
    done
    set r to r + 1
  done
  help('Left/Right change the day')
done

      when from_omar(m)
        set total to total + 1
      done
    done
